title.zh: Kraken获得迪拜全面牌照后计划进军阿联酋
title.en: Kraken Plans UAE Launch After Securing Full Dubai License

current_state.zh: Payward 已获得迪拜 VARA 全面市场批准；Kraken 计划数周内在阿联酋上线，提供 AED 现货与保证金交易、AED 存取款、链上质押、xStocks 代币化股票、机构 OTC/Prime 服务，并计划自 2026 年底起推出衍生品，尚待进一步批准。
current_state.en: Payward has received full market approval from Dubai's VARA; Kraken plans UAE launch within weeks with AED spot and margin trading, AED deposits/withdrawals, onchain staking, xStocks tokenized stocks, institutional OTC/Prime services, and derivatives planned from late 2026 onward subject to further approval.

updates.title_zh: Kraken获得迪拜全面牌照后计划进军阿联酋
updates.title_en: Kraken Plans UAE Launch After Securing Full Dubai License
updates.what_changed_zh: Kraken已获得迪拜全面牌照，并计划在Payward牌照下推出阿联酋服务，包括迪拉姆存取款、AED交易对、质押以及面向零售用户的xStocks。
updates.what_changed_en: Kraken has obtained a full Dubai license and plans to launch UAE services including dirham deposits and withdrawals, AED trading pairs, staking and xStocks for retail users under the Payward license.

updates.current_state_en: Kraken has obtained a full Dubai license and plans to launch UAE services including dirham deposits and withdrawals, AED trading pairs, staking and xStocks for retail users under the Payward license.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Kraken has obtained a full Dubai license and plans to launch UAE services including dirham deposits and withdrawals, AED trading pairs, staking and xStocks for retail users under the Payward license.

updates.title_zh: Payward获得迪拜VARA全面市场批准；Kraken计划进军阿联酋
updates.title_en: Payward Receives Full Market Approval from Dubai’s VARA; Kraken Plans UAE Launch
updates.what_changed_zh: Payward 获得迪拜 VARA 全面市场批准（此前于5月获初步批准）；Kraken 现计划数周内在阿联酋上线，新增 AED 现货与保证金交易、机构 OTC/Kraken Prime，并计划自 2026 年底起推出衍生品，尚待进一步批准。
updates.what_changed_en: Payward received full market approval from Dubai's VARA (after preliminary approval in May); Kraken now plans UAE launch within weeks, adding AED spot and margin trading, institutional OTC/Kraken Prime, and derivatives planned from late 2026 onward, subject to further approval.
updates.current_state_zh: Payward 已获得迪拜 VARA 全面市场批准；Kraken 计划数周内在阿联酋上线，提供 AED 现货与保证金交易、AED 存取款、链上质押、xStocks 代币化股票、机构 OTC/Prime 服务，并计划自 2026 年底起推出衍生品，尚待进一步批准。
updates.current_state_en: Payward has received full market approval from Dubai's VARA; Kraken plans UAE launch within weeks with AED spot and margin trading, AED deposits/withdrawals, onchain staking, xStocks tokenized stocks, institutional OTC/Prime services, and derivatives planned from late 2026 onward subject to further approval.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Kraken parent Payward obtained full market approval from Dubai's VARA, paving the way for a UAE launch within weeks offering AED spot and margin trading, onchain staking, tokenized stocks via xStocks and institutional OTC/Prime services, with derivatives planned for late 2026 onward.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Kraken parent Payward obtained full market approval from Dubai's VARA, paving the way for a UAE launch within weeks offering AED spot and margin trading, onchain staking, tokenized stocks via xStocks and institutional OTC/Prime services, with derivatives planned for late 2026 onward.
